import numpy as np
def T(tau,nu=3,N=12):
    y=tau.imag; r=range(-N,N+1)
    P=np.array([(a+b*tau.real,b*y) for a in r for b in r if (a,b)!=(0,0)])/np.sqrt(y)
    P=P[np.hypot(*P.T)<8]
    n=np.hypot(*P.T)
    d=np.hypot(P[:,None,0]-P[None,:,0],P[:,None,1]-P[None,:,1])
    m=d>1e-9
    f=(n[:,None]*n[None,:]*np.where(m,d,1))**-nu
    return (f*m).sum()
for t in [1j,0.5+np.sqrt(3)/2*1j,0.5+1.2j,0.3+1.1j,0.2+1.5j,2j]:
